title: Surface the ma_stack top-decile certified edge on Evidence + Research factor lab
rationale: Top NEW triad survivor (triad_score 1.230, #2 cell behind only the already-surfaced leadership_score). Scores on all three legs at once: positive return, the lowest drawdown among the strong-return survivors, and max frequency, with a POSITIVE stable rank-IC (the factor actually sorts forward returns). Hold-out edge +0.0262 > required 0.0031 (edge-persisted, 351 holdout dates). Trend-alignment factor; decile 10 = strongest MA stack. Promoted to J-06.

title: entry_quality_score bottom-decile inverse edge (contrarian)
rationale: Hold-out survivor (triad_score 0.861, holdout edge +0.0506) but NEGATIVE rank-IC: it is decile 1 (LOW entry quality) that outperforms, an INVERSE relationship to the score's intended semantic. Surfacing it as 'Proven' on the entry_quality_score badge would contradict the score's meaning and confuse the user, and its drawdown leg is weak (-0.1923). Robust survivor, NOT promoted this cycle (confusing/contradictory UX; revisit only as a clearly-labeled inverse-factor view).

title: high_proximity top-decile (near-52w-high) certified edge
rationale: Hold-out survivor with the BEST positive rank-IC among all survivors (+0.0265) and the smallest drawdown (-0.1063); intuitive (proximity to 52-week high leads). But its engine triad_score is negative (-0.062, ranked #4) — the project's combined lens does not favor it as strongly as ma_stack this batch. Robust survivor held in backlog; strong second candidate for a later cycle.

title: hv top-decile (high historical volatility) certified edge
rationale: Hold-out survivor (holdout edge +0.0539) but FAILS the drawdown leg badly (-0.2149, the deepest of any survivor) and has a negative rank-IC; triad_score -0.109. High return is paid for with high risk — poor on the triad's lower-drawdown leg. Robust but NOT promoted.

title: vcp_contraction top-decile certified edge
rationale: Hold-out survivor (holdout edge +0.0333) but negative rank-IC and modest return; triad_score -0.436. Robust but low usefulness by the lens — NOT promoted.

title: up_down_vol top-decile certified edge
rationale: Weakest hold-out survivor (triad_score -0.757): near-zero rank-IC (no real sorting power), modest return, sizeable drawdown, and the thinnest hold-out edge (+0.0100, only just above the required 0.0031). Robust by the screen but lowest usefulness — NOT promoted.
